Discover our platform

Three products, one platform. Pick where you want to start.

Vibe

The unified agent for productivity and coding. Chat with it on the web or mobile, or run it in your terminal and editor.

Studio

The developer console and the Mistral API. Keys, the Playground, evaluations, agents, and SDKs to ship applications.

Admin

The control plane for organization setup, billing, SSO, Workspaces, and access policies.

Quickstarts

Self-contained walkthroughs grouped by product and role. Most take 15 minutes or less.

Open Vibe Work, run a multi-step task end-to-end, and review the result.

5 min to complete

Analyze a dataset

Upload a spreadsheet and ask questions in plain language. Work writes and runs code.

10 min to complete

10 min to complete

Install the Vibe CLI

5 min to complete

5 min to complete

Test a model in the API playground

Send prompts, adjust parameters, and compare model outputs in the Studio playground.

5 min to complete

Save a prompt template with versions and a clear usage description.
